_comment: TTTR <-> .pto converter, native emtk window. Drawn by emtk.view_form over TttrToPtoModel (gui/model.py), the generated Input section (workspace photon streams) spliced in first; Help and Guide are drawn by gui/app.py.
title: TTTR <-> .pto

sections.text: Pick photon streams in the Input section: vendor files (.ptu, .spc, .ht3, ...) are packed into one .pto beside the first; a stream of a .pto unpacks the original vendor file(s) back out. The source is kept untouched, and what is written appears in the workspace under it.
sections.description: What the tool does: what you pick decides the direction, and nothing is changed or deleted. Files enter ChiSurf by dropping them on the ChiSurf window.
Convert the example, or forget the finished entries.

buttons.label: Load example
buttons.description: Write the shared demonstration SPC stream (seeded, shaped like an SPC-132 measurement) in the settings cache, add it to the workspace and convert it to a .pto.

buttons.label: Clear history
buttons.description: Remove the finished entries from the list; the files on disk stay untouched.

sections.description: How many conversions were asked for and how they ended.

One row per conversion, newest last. A vendor file is packed into a .pto beside it (files dropped together become one container, in file-name order); a .pto is unpacked to the vendor files and results it holds. Hover a row for the full paths.

columns.title: Status
columns.tooltip: Queued, Converting, Verified (the written file passed its checksum), Failed, Rejected or Not completed.

columns.title: Action
columns.tooltip: Pack: vendor file(s) into a .pto. Unpack: a .pto back to its vendor file(s) and results.

columns.title: Files
columns.tooltip: The file(s) you dropped, in the order they are packed.

columns.title: Result
columns.tooltip: The file(s) written, or why the conversion failed or the file was rejected.
